{{Quote|We'll put a request in through the proper channels. Just sit down and relax. Someone is on the way.|The customs guard to Teff'ith|<ref name="The Old Republic: Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3640 BBY]] he was serving as a guard with the [[Customs Enforcement Division]] at [[Diplomatic Spaceport 27-B]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] name [[Teff'ith]] briefly took the individual hostage to ensure that [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] would be informed of her presence. The individual's [[Unidentified Coruscant Security customs guard 2|partner]] called for backup and over twenty CSF officers responded to the scene. The hostage situation was resolved when Grand Master Shan arrived and Teff'ith surrendered.

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security officer first appeared in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' which was written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and published on [[November 13]], [[2012]].
